ai_summary: Cipla Limited announced that Mr. Sanjay Joseph, Head - API Business, will cease to be a Senior Managerial Personnel (SMP) effective July 24, 2026, due to an internal change in his reporting structure. This signifies an organizational adjustment within the company's API business segment. While not explicitly a resignation or removal, the somewhat vague reason for the reporting change could prompt further inquiry into the stability and strategic direction of this key unit.
